description: This file defines the SerializerSession class, which manages contextual information during serialization operations in Orleans. It includes properties for type codecs, well-known types, referenced types/objects, and methods for resetting internal state.

classes.name: SerializerSession
classes.description: Handles the session state and context for serialization processes, including type codecs, references, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: SerializerSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with type codec, well known types, and codec provider.

methods.name: PartialReset
methods.description: Resets only the referenced objects collection.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Performs a full reset of referenced objects and types collections.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the session, invoking the OnDisposed callback if set.
